2025 Topps® Finest Football Chase Guide: Top Rookies, Autos & More
The Chase is on for Topps® Finest Football

TOPICS: 2025 TOPPS FINEST FOOTBALL, FOOTBALL, NFL, PRODUCT, TOPPS FINEST FOOTBALL, TRENDING
LENGTH: 1224 WORDS
READING TIME: ~7 MINUTES

2025 Topps Finest Football brings the iconic brand back to the gridiron with a bang. Innovation, color, and premium football card design continue to carry the day for a release that already has The Hobby talking. With its newest football release, Finest once again pushes the boundaries.

For decades, Finest has celebrated The Hobby’s most electrifying stars and emerging talent. That trend continues for the 2025 Football set. Driven by bold design and a modern edge, 2025 Topps Finest Football once again creates a benchmark in collecting, bringing The Hobby chase cards worthy of becoming collection centerpieces.

2025 Topps Finest Football is a premium NFL trading card release featuring a 300-card tiered base set, colorful Refractor parallels, autographs, rookie chase cards, and artistic inserts. The product blends classic Finest chrome styling with modern NFL stars, legends, and top rookie talent.

Combining the Refractor-driven excitement of the ’90s with today’s superstars and chase rookies, 2025 Topps Finest Football offers a bold and bright chase for all collectors. As Finest brings its iconic brand back to the gridiron, let’s take a look at some of the top cards to chase in the new release.

Chase the Base: Three Tiers for Set Collectors

A chase so nice you can do it thrice, 2025 Topps Finest Football features a three-tiered base set including common, uncommon, and rare variations, spicing up the challenge for set collectors.

The 300-card base set captures a wide array of chase rookies such as Jaxson Dart, Cam Ward, Tetairoa McMillan, and Cam Skattebo. Star veterans like Josh Allen, Patrick Mahomes, Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson, and Bijan Robinson are there to be found as well.

If it’s legends you’re after, Tom Brady, Peyton Manning, Randy Moss, Troy Aikman, Jerry Rice, and Eli Manning are all there for the hunt. Chase the full set across all three tiers.

The Finest Ink: Autographs to Chase

2025 Topps Finest Football carries on the brand’s tradition of delivering top-shelf ink on top-shelf cards. Eye-catching Finest Autographs like this low-numbered Drake Maye parallel will make any collection pop.

Flashback Autographs is a curated subset that includes chase rookies Jaxson Dart and Cam Ward, alongside rising stars like Jahmyr Gibbs and Hobby superstars like Jayden Daniels. This color-matched Bo Nix limited to 25 copies features his own inscription of his jersey number.

A top Superfractor chase in 2025 Topps Finest Football comes in this subset, with Giants franchise player Jaxson Dart coming in hot with a unique “Big Blue” inscription including a smiley-face and his #6 inscribed on the card not once, but twice.

Finest Rookies & Freshman: For Rookie Collectors

Chase a loaded rookie class in 2025 Topps Finest Football, including Tetairoa McMillan, Cam Ward, Cam Skattebo, Jaxson Dart, and more. Stylish parallels on the Topps Rookie Finest Autographs checklist offer an array of intriguing color match options in Finest Freshman Autographs, adding a chase layer to an already highly coveted 10-card auto subset.

Chase Cam Skattebo and Jaxson Dart in Blue parallels limited to 99 copies, or Ashton Jeanty in a bold Black parallel numbered to 10. Rare, low-numbered parallels, including Superfractors of both Rookie First Autographs and Finest Freshman Autographs, are among the most sought-after cards in the set.

Nightmare Fuel & Centurions: For Stylish Insert Collectors

Nightmare Fuel showcases the otherworldly defenders who keep the opposition up at night, including NFL single-season sacks record-holder Myles Garrett.

Centurions celebrates the most commanding players in the league with a remarkably stylish flair born of fire.

Smashing Through: For Design-Forward Collectors

For collectors who prioritize innovative design, 2025 Topps Finest Football presents Smashing Through. The striking insert mesmerizes without overwhelming, with the player image set as if to be exploding free of the card itself.

Moments & Greats: For Legacy Collectors

2025 Topps Finest Football honors the legacy of the the brand, while driving it forward into a new era on the gridiron. Finest Moments Autographs have long been a foundational chase in Finest releases, and this set brings the heat, showcasing The Hobby’s biggest stars in a perfect subset for star and legacy collectors.

These spectacular chase cards, including Josh Allen diving headfirst in Red, offer collectors a chance to capture the moment. Another gem is Saquon Barkley’s Finest Moments Auto card, featuring one of the most famous plays of his career, when he preposterously pulled off a backward hurdle over the opposition.

To pay homage to those who built the NFL into the powerhouse it is today, 2025 Topps Finest Football also brings ink from the legends of the gridiron. The Finest Greats Autographs subset includes Hall-of-Fame signers such as Eric Dickerson, Jerry Rice, and Archie and Eli Manning.

For extra retro flair, keep an eye out for throwback insert 1992 Finest, an homage to the first Finest cards ever made.

The Man & Headliners: For Art-Forward Collectors

2025 Topps Finest Football brings collectors a range of ways to get after the superstars defining The Hobby and the league. The NFL’s best are here for the chase in spectacular art-forward insert The Man, featuring the likes of Saquon Barkley, Josh Allen, and Joe Burrow.

Headliners is another popular crossover insert, taking to the gridiron for the first time this year. Oversized heads create player-forward imagery set against compelling artwork. The subset features 15 of the NFL’s best, including Brady and Mahomes.

Framed White: For Collectors of Elegance

2025 Topps Finest Football shows that when it comes to the chase, there’s a beauty in simplicity. Framed White delivers a 25-card subset that looks like it belongs in a museum, including chase rookies Cam Ward, Emeka Egbuka, and Jaxson Dart.

Finest Fans: Chase the Famous

The NFL is one of the most popular sporting leagues in the world, and 2025 Topps Finest Football takes a chance to show off the A-List fans who have gravitated to the exciting competition. From Hobby superstar Mike Trout and Hollywood’s Anne Hathaway (both Eagles fans) to Steph Curry and his Carolina Panthers, this subset celebrates the connection between fan and team.
